four_layer_diagnosis.measurement: under-instrumented at the control layer -- (a) the registered matched-noise control fired (Factor B gap_scaled_commit_active 0.91-1.00) yet lifted committed-class entropy over the collapsed proposer on only 2/4 seeds. This is the FOURTH failed construction of a verified-lifting committed-class noise null in the MECH-439 lineage: V3-EXQ-689c (Factor B on the e2wf source, recorded T_eff ~2.3-2.4, lifts <= +0.025 or negative; fallback_ladder rung 1 'REFUTED ... DO NOT re-propose'), V3-EXQ-689i (proposer-source Factor B, 1/4, including a single-class-collapse cell at seed 43), V3-EXQ-700d (field noise magnitude-matched at 1.0x, 0/2 verified lifting, destructive) and now 1095. 'Both verified lifting' is plausibly unmeetable BY THESIS on this substrate -- a score-scale monopoly that caps conversion of injected diversity is what MECH-439 asserts -- rather than mis-calibrated. (b) The candidate_first_action_classes readiness gate aggregates by WORST SEED of the whole arm while every verdict criterion aggregates by >=3/4 seeds, so one seed vacates all 16 cells: the F3 shape the driver already fixed for C_CONTROL_DISTINCT, left in place for this gate. (c) Recording: gap_scaled_commit_temperature_eff / gap_norm (e3_selector.py:2320-2334) and conflict_gap_norm are emitted per tick but never read by the driver, so a magnitude shortfall cannot be told apart from a near-uniform softmax over a class-poor E (red-team pass-1 F3). Neither (a) nor (b) changes the verdict under the pre-registered bar (see counterfactual).

targets.counterfactual_verdict: Robust to both measurement defects UNDER THE PRE-REGISTERED 3-of-4 BAR. The pre-registered thresholds bind, so the verdict is unaffected. The design cannot reach weakens.

learning_extracted: MEASUREMENT (NOT new -- fourth instance): MECH-439's 'collapsed-proposer plus magnitude-matched-noise control, both verified lifting' requirement has now failed in four constructions -- 689c (Factor B, e2wf source, T_eff ~2.4, lifts <= +0.025), 689i (Factor B, proposer, 1/4), 700d (field noise magnitude-matched 1.0x, 0/2, destructive; already in MECH-439's own notes), and 1095 (Factor B, proposer, 2/4). One of those was explicitly magnitude-calibrated. So 'verified lifting' is plausibly unmeetable BY THESIS on this substrate -- injected diversity failing to convert is the F-monopoly/score-scale reading itself -- not a calibration fault. Same family as GFLAG-0480: part of MECH-439's registered control set cannot carry its own DV.

TEST-DESIGN GAP (template): the readiness gate aggregates by worst seed per arm while verdicts aggregate >=3/4 seeds, so one seed's pathology vacates every arm. That is the same regression shape the driver already repaired for C_CONTROL_DISTINCT (red-team pass-2 F3). Future drivers in this lineage should exclude a failing SEED from the paired contrasts rather than red the whole arm.

PRE-REGISTERED GRID: the ungated result sits in the queue entry's H3 cell (summary-source-not-operator: C1 true, C1b false). ARM_OFF also clears both controls on 2/4, and H_off mean 0.869 is above both control means. H2 (ceiling-is-downstream, C1 false) did NOT occur. The single seed-level observation that speaks to H2 is seed 43, a genuine commit-stage null (operator engaged, R_ON 0.70, committed split byte-identical to OFF). The earlier draft reading that 'attribution does not track R_ON, so the bottleneck is downstream' is WITHDRAWN (red-team F2): it rested on 3 free points against a pre-registered grid that places the run elsewhere.

SCOPE BOUND (found by Step 7b C2): SD-056's open 571b item (clamp-armed E3 score-range collapse) applies to this run in 16/16 cells and was not in the driver's Step 2.5c known-limitations list. It is arm-uniform, so it does not threaten the non_contributory verdict. It does weaken the 'bottleneck is downstream at final-commit' reading above, because a compressed-score clamped regime could equally explain weak conversion. RECORDING GAP: committed score range / clamp-pinned fraction per cell was not recorded, so the two cannot be told apart from this manifest. Any follow-on in this lineage (the noise-control calibration, the final-commit replay) should record max||z_w||/ceiling and committed score range per cell.

CONFOUND CONFIRMED: ON's lift over both controls (C1 4/4) is not operator-specific. ARM_OFF (e2wf source, operator OFF) also exceeds both controls on 2/4 seeds, and H_off mean 0.869 sits above both control means (0.772 / 0.804). The C1b attribution contrast the red-team added was load-bearing; without it the run would have read as a clean conversion.

ENVIRONMENT: seed 43's candidate pool is binary in every arm, including proposer-sourced ones, which puts the limit upstream of candidate_summary_source. That is read-across to e3_fdominance_causal_discrimination H3-upstream-insufficiency (not adjudicated).
